notes: Run of 2026-11-27. Four Chronicle Bluesky posts queued, two stories. Published: the demolition of the 'Tom and Jerry' Christmas house at 3650 21st Street (both posts point at the one article). Not written: the Tenderloin shooting on the 200 block of Leavenworth names no address and is a crime story, not a building story.

findings.description: The single-family house at 3650 21st Street, known for decades for its holiday light display, has been demolished; the city issued a demolition permit in April 2026, and a separate permit authorizes a new four-story, two-unit building over a basement. Article dated 26 Nov 2026; the demolition itself is undated ('this week ... construction underway'), so the article date stands. The replacement is not built: its architect stays in extra, not building.

citation.label: San Francisco Chronicle, “San Francisco’s beloved ‘Tom and Jerry’ Christmas house is torn down,” 26 November 2026

raw.text: The residence at 3650 21st St. was famous for its towering Norfolk Island pine
